reason: I already have my brand and I reorder it when it runs out. Switching means paying for a new box to find out if it even does anything for me, and I have no reason to rock that.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I've never felt much from magnesium, and a lab report doesn't tell me that. Plus it's a brand I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: A gym buddy or a creator I trust showing real results after a few weeks, or a free sample sachet to try before paying.
